typography_and_graphic_elements.__note: No overlay typography or logos. Small framed artwork prints on the background wall are miniature and abstract.

negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, smooth CGI plastic, digital 3D render, Pixar style, Disney style, photorealistic human skin, real human flesh, modern restaurant, cold fluorescent lighting, flat lighting, deformed hands, extra fingers, cartoon 2D drawing
reconstruction_priority: tactile stop-motion physical materials (matte clay face, real corduroy apron texture, chunky wool knitwear) — AI often renders generic smooth 3D plastic
distinctive wild white halo hair structure and gentle facial features — AI frequently turns into messy noise or generic cartoon hair
striking complementary lighting (warm amber pendant pools vs cool slate-blue background walls) — AI often flattens into a single monochromatic wash
intricate miniature bistro props (steaming kettle, bentwood chairs, bread roll, wooden counter) — AI frequently simplifies or melts small furniture details
